projects.name: and Resilience Squad — Enterprise Integration & Governance (Domain: BFSI)
details: Lead enterprise-level requirement discovery, strategy formulation, and scope management activities across high-impact business process re-engineering and digital transformation initiatives.
Facilitate advanced process discovery workshops and stakeholder interviews leveraging Pega GenAI framework to design optimized future-state corporate business models.
Utilize Pega GenAI capabilities and integrated AI tools to ingest legacy documentation, accelerating the creation of High-Fidelity Pega Blueprints, multi-tiered case stages, and persona mappings.
Translate complex business goals and risk governance strategies into highly scalable functional designs, identifying framework feature variances and aligning with architectural best practices.
Oversee agile sprint planning, backlog prioritization, and operational governance, leveraging AI accelerators to author complex epics, user stories, and comprehensive functional specifications.
Manage secure cross-platform system integrations involving SSH and PGP encryption protocols, resolving environment readiness constraints in collaboration with infrastructure teams.
Standardize organizational change management documentation, creating frameworks for rollback planning, risk categorization, and audit-ready traceability matrices.

Developed Business Capability Maps for Cross-Border Payments, covering payment initiation, validation, routing, processing, exception management, investigation, reconciliation and settlement, and identified capability gaps between current and target states.

Created end-to-end Customer Journey Maps for Cross-Border Payments, analysing customer pain points, manual touchpoints, processing delays and service gaps, and defining future-state journeys aligned with the transformation roadmap.
